title: Rab Jaane Zakhmi Asghar Kivey Maa Nai Vekheya Ay
body:
Baih Khaak Tay Gayi Ay, Tak Puttar Da Galla Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Uss Wailay Hil Gayi Si, Khaliq Di Kul Khudai,
Jadou Garm Rait Shah Nai, Asghar Dai Muu Tay Payi,
Asghar Nu Dafan Karna, Bas Shah Da Housla Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar Di Karbala Wich, Dhup Tay Kabar Bani Ay,
Abid Meri Sakina, Zindan Ch Mar Gayi Ay,
Zahra Day Waang Mera, Sab Kuch Ujar Gaya Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Tareekh Wich Na Aisi Mildi Koi Misaal Ay,
Chay Mah Da Ek Sipahi, Laray Ashkiya Dai Naal Ay,
Tera Jihad Asghar, Islam Di Baqa Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere Waang Shalla Asghar, Ujran Kaday Na Mavaan,
Ro Ro Ke Din Guzarday, Ratan Nu Vain Pavaan,
Tu Piyasa Tur Gaya Ay, Ay Dard Kha Gaya Ay
